notes: חָנֵף is realized twice — as the possessive *his* recasting the construct relation of פֶה חָנֵף (rule 29's possessive recasting) and as the clause's subject *the godless man* — so both belong to its one discontinuous unit under rule 25. The competing reading marks *his* `added` under rule 18's closing sentence; it is rejected because the possessor is the written rectum, not a relation the ASV supplied.
The generic *man* joins that unit under rule 31 and the head stays on *godless*, the word carrying the lexeme.
